history.content: We shortlisted HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Salesforce and Close for a 20-person sales team. What do they cost?
Per seat per month, billed annually: HubSpot Sales Hub Starter $20, Pipedrive Essential $14, Zoho CRM Standard $14, Salesforce Sales Pro $100, Close Startup $9.

message: On Monday we shortlisted 5 CRM tools for a 20-person sales team. Has any of them changed pricing or shipped something big since?
